## Sound

- Music is often used as a motivator while training and the volume should never exceed 90dB

## Electrical

- Grounded outlets (GFCI) should be used at all times throughout the room and plenty of outlets should be installed to accommodate all electronic equipment (cleaning machines also need access to electrical outlets)

## Signage

- Signage can assist athletes in emergency procedures, operational policies, rules, and safety guidelines
